mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( receiver_id, actor_id, order_id, chat_room_id, chat_message_id, post_id, comment_id, review_id, review_reply_id, user_coupon_id, notification_type, title, content, delivery_scope, is_read, read_at, event_key, created_at, last_event_at ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{actorId}, #{orderId}, #{chatRoomId}, #{chatMessageId}, #{postId}, #{commentId}, #{reviewId}, #{reviewReplyId}, #{userCouponId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{deliveryScope}, #{isRead}, #{readAt}, #{eventKey}, #{createdAt}, #{lastEventAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.notification_type AS type, n.title, n.content, n.is_read AS isRead, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.last_event_at AS lastEventAt, n.order_id AS orderId, COALESCE(n.chat_room_id, cm.chat_room_id) AS chatRoomId, COALESCE(n.post_id, c.post_id) AS postId, n.comment_id AS commentId, COALESCE(n.review_id, rr.review_id) AS reviewId, n.user_coupon_id AS userCouponId FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.id = n.comment_id LEFT JOIN chat_messages cm ON cm.id = n.chat_message_id LEFT JOIN review_replies rr ON rr.id = n.review_reply_id WHERE n.receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY n.last_event_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = true, read_at = NOW() WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT true FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND event_key = #{eventKey} LIMIT 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET last_event_at = NOW(), is_read = false, read_at = NULL, title = COALESCE(#{title}, title), content = COALESCE(#{content}, content) WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND event_key = #{eventKey}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT true FROM notification_deliveries WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND status = 'SENT' LIMIT 1 )
SELECT COALESCE(o.orderer_phone, m.phone) FROM members m LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = #{orderId} AND o.member_id = m.id WHERE m.id = #{receiverId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_deliveries ( notification_id, recipient, template_code, provider_message_id, status, failure_reason, sent_at, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{recipient}, #{templateCode}, #{providerMessageId}, #{status}, #{failureReason}, #{sentAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
